definitions.gloss: fork in the road, branching path
definitions.explanation: A point where a road splits into two or more directions. Also used figuratively for a critical turning point or decision.

examples.japanese: {分|わ}かれ{道|みち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がった→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。
examples.english: I turned right at the fork in the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|わ}かれ{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm standing at a crossroads in life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、{分|わ}かれ{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I stood at the crossroads of continuing my education or getting a job, my mentor's words gave me the push I needed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{分|わ}かれ→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧ (branching, from ⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧) + ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road, path). Used both literally and figuratively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分|わ}かれ{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand at a crossroads)
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|わ}かれ{道|みち} (crossroads of life)
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|わ}かれ{道|みち} (fateful turning point)

USAGE:
The figurative meaning (a critical decision point) is at least as common as the literal meaning. The expression {分|わ}かれ{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand at a crossroads) is a standard metaphor for facing a major life decision.
